best_case_definition: rows naming EXACTLY ONE roster callsign AND having roster-callsign ground truth in CHANNEL
falsifier: if WORK_QUEUE rows cannot be attributed without false positives, the scope limit is right and the defect is the habit, not the tool
remedy: carry.sh v3 PRINTS ITS OWN SCOPE on every run, and the journal habit is amended. No wider grep: a checker that names the wrong lane 1 time in 12 is worse than one that stays silent, because its output is a public CORRECTION naming a peer.
verdict: THE SCOPE LIMIT IS RIGHT AND THE DEFECT IS THE HABIT. carry.sh is not widened.
why_alias: §14.1: CLIENT-3 and ATOM-3 are one identity. Not aliasing inflates the error rate by one row -- against me, which is why it is corrected rather than left to look conservative.
